candidate.definition_en: A small organized dissenting group within a larger one, especially in politics.
candidate.explanation_ar: مجموعة صغيرة أو 'فصيل' جوه حزب أو مجموعة أكبر، وغالباً بيكون ليهم رأي مختلف عن الباقيين.

senses.definition_en: A small organized dissenting group within a larger one, especially in politics.
senses.definition_ar: فصيل أو جماعة منشقة ذات توجه خاص داخل هيئة أو حزب سياسي أكبر.
examples: A radical faction within the party voted against the proposed tax reform.
The committee was dominated by an influential faction that opposed any leadership changes.
A rival faction inside the organization attempted to block the merger.
A radical faction within the party voted against the proposed tax reform.
The committee was dominated by an influential faction that opposed any leadership changes.
A rival faction inside the organization attempted to block the merger.
candidate.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Fraction' (جزء).. فالـ 'Faction' هو جزء أو فصيل منشق عن مجموعة أكبر.
